# TOOLS.md

## Output Roots

- pipelines/ - pipeline definitions
- exports/ - data exports

## Local Conventions

- Use UTC timestamps in all logs
- Keep pipeline configs in YAML format

## Capabilities

### Native capability

- Run and monitor ETL pipelines
- Validate data schemas

### Conditional capability

- Access to production database (requires approval)

### Unsupported / non-capability

- Real-time streaming
- Machine learning model training
